title: Add discount rules to the cart
body:
Adds discount rules to the shopping cart.

## What changes

- New `DiscountRule` interface and the rule `PercentOverMinimum`.
- `CartService.total()` adds up the discount of every rule.
- The old `LegacyCoupon` object is removed.

```kotlin
val cart = CartService(prices, listOf(PercentOverMinimum(10, Money.of(50))))
```

See the [design note](https://github.example.test/acme/shop/blob/main/docs/discounts.md) and the
[ticket](https://tracker.example.test/SHOP-412).

![scheme](https://github.example.test/acme/shop/assets/discount-scheme.png)
![tracker](https://images.example.test/tracking-pixel.png)

Ping @bob-reviewer for the price rounding.
